page.layout: One column of running text on a single printed page; running head at top; page number top right; catchword-style signature "Qq" and "Suc." at the foot centre-right; faint show-through from the reverse page in the background, not transcribed; no marginal notes.

main_text.p: PALLIUM extrema vestis apud Græcos, ut Toga apud Romanos: & tunicam tegebat: ideoq; tunica propior corpori, quàm pal- lium.
ERANT servi vestipici: & ancillæ vestipicæ: quæ aliàs dictæ à veste in Antiqq. Inscript.
TUNICAM, zonam, chlamydem, & caufiam sumebant peregri- naturi.
MATRONÆ promissos crines alebant, scorta breviores.

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page is visible in the background and was omitted. Doubtful readings: "noviiih" (possibly "novitii"), "cinĉiculis" (cincticulis), "Judicÿ" and "Conjugÿ" as printed. Marginal dots and a small reference mark near the right edge are not text.
